rows: `afkv2_config.py` reads and checks the `frontends` list of `.afkv2/config.json` (name, source, catalog) and answers it, `[]` when absent.
The config reader is its own module in SDD §8, and both new skills read its frontends list, so it comes first.
`launcher.py open --plain` opens a file in lavish without writing the afkv2 tooltip block into it; the pin and host checks stay.
One flag on the launcher, its own public interface, with no dependency on the new skills.

`prototype_files.py` answers `start` (frontend, live block, anchor, paths), `check` (network calls, afkv2 runtime) and `settle` (PROTOTYPE.md shape, secret scan, INDEX Prototype row); `PROTOTYPE-FORMAT.md` holds the file format, and `INDEX-FORMAT.md` names prototype as the Prototype row writer.
The start, check and settle verbs of skills/prototype; the network check is reused by design-system.
`mockup_show.py` shows a mockup through the launcher with `--plain`, writes the Codex waiting record, and `wait` writes each note with uid, prompt, selector, tag and text to the notes file.
The lavish wrapper needs the plain open and the settle verb, and owns the lavish poll seam.
The no-document branch of `codex_stop.py` prints 1 line per note with its tag, selector and text; a page with a page document gives the same output as today.
The Codex hook is its own module and depends only on the launcher's existing waiting record.
The prototype skill text and its canvas rules: anchors, the notes loop over lavish or chat, chat only, `no_ui`, made-up data, the settle, and the hands-off park.
The skill text cites the commands of 0003 and 0004, so it follows them.
`catalog_files.py start|add-frontend|check`, `CATALOG-FORMAT.md` and the design-system SKILL.md: one catalog per frontend in the repository, checked cards, no outward push.
Its own module in SDD §8; it reuses the network check and the config list, and its park check reads both skill files.
Both start answers add `prototype` and `prototype_exists` and never refuse a missing file; both SKILL.md files read it as an optional input.
The 2 reader changes are 1 interface change of SDD §8 and trace the Coverage table of 0003.

Write `afkv2/tests/live/PROTOTYPE-LIVE-CHECKS.md` with the real-session checks VR-001, VR-002, VR-003, VR-018, VR-004, VR-005, VR-006, VR-016, VR-022, VR-025, VR-026, each with its given, when and then as in VERIFICATION.md's owner card; register the 2 skill folders and module names.
Registration and the owner checklist need every other file to exist, so it runs last.
